title: Bound-Tightened Densest Subgraph Discovery on GPU
gpu_scope: GPU densest-subgraph discovery; its generalized formulation includes ordinary edge-density when clique size is two.
notes: The author repository contains the paper's CUDA implementation. For k=2 its k-clique-density objective is ordinary unweighted densest-subgraph density; k=3 and k=4 are higher-order variants.
